description: s441 fix round 3 (review N2). A handler that awaits a server call calls preventDefault through string-literal bracket access (`event["preventDefault"]()`) after that await. The browser has already submitted the form by then (reviewer-executed: defaultPrevented false on the branch, true on main before the handler became async). Round 2 matched only a direct `event.preventDefault()`; the event is now followed by binding through aliases, bracket access and closures, and the build fails closed.
rationale: §13.2: event control on the handler's event parameter after its first await SHALL be a compile error (E-EVENT-CONTROL-AFTER-AWAIT, §34).
